author: Fextralife
description:
Soulmask Gameplay UPDATE 1.0 & Shifting Sands DLC - Should You Play it?
In this video, we're gonna be taking another look at Soulmask, which is a tribe survival game with some action combat that went into early access in May of 2024, whch is when we made our first video on the game, Since then, the game has been very well received having a 79% on Steam and the reason we're doing this video is that the version 1.0 of the game is actually releasing on April 10th, which is not too far away. 

Along with a new DLC for the game called Shifing Sands, all of the footage you're going to see in today's video are almost all of it is from the DLC, which is quite fun. It takes place in Egypt, so I'm going to kinda run you through what you can expect and why you might want to check this out.

Get the Game HERE:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646460?utm_source=2034 
Sponsored by: Qooland Games and Campfire Studio
